description: Draft of the v2 personality traits after review. 'origin' is 'v1' for traits kept from v1 (instruction unchanged) and 'new' otherwise. 'relevant_if_either_response' completes the sentence 'The trait is relevant if either response …'. 'via' lists news coverage of the source it is attached to. 'review_note' is for review only and is not part of the annotation prompt.
